description: Rest spaces and gate structures placed from the SCNU 360 VR tour (visual reference only, nothing copied) and checked against the NGII 2025 orthophoto; read by stages/furniture.mjs after objects-campus.geojson. RS-GATE-A19: the A19 gate sign (todo 14). RS0001-RS0018: VR-located rest spaces (data/photo/README.md 'VR rest spaces'): one feature per rest-space sighting of rest-spaces-reconciliation.json decided missing and placed, kind = data/rest-space-catalogue.json type. photo_support roof/wall: outline traced on the NGII 2025 sheet (within 0.25 m of the photo); none: VR-only position (bearing and depression angle from the VR station, or a nadir face registered on road markings), confidence <= 0.4. RS-LS-*: VR landscape items (steps, pond, sign stone, PM rack) the VR shows and the survey lacks (rest-spaces-reconciliation.json landscape rows decided missing), built by the furniture builders of their kind; photo_support outline: footprint or bottom edge traced on the NGII 2025 sheet. Every value is an estimate (추정).

properties.height_source: VR scene_a19 + scene_001 (estimated)
properties.note: 국립순천대학교 / SCNU letter sign on a planted stone bed at the road edge of the A19 gate plaza. From the scene_a19 camera over the gate crossing (about 244182, 263716, 11.7 m from the car scale on the d face) the letters span l cols 693-981 (bearings 176-192 deg) and their base sits about 21 deg below the horizon, and the slab subtends about 16 deg: about 25 m south of the camera, just inside the plaza edge wall OC0128. Lettering not modelled (plain white slab and name band). Supersedes the survey point OC0111 (left out).
